name: comp-545
blurb: Dropzone with centered image preview, aspect-ratio preserved.
description: Drag-and-drop upload for single image with centered, contain-fit display. Shows instructions when empty; supports SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF.
use_when: Icon uploads, logo uploads, or cases where image aspect ratio must be preserved.
avoid_when: Full-bleed cover images; use comp-544 for that.
a11y: Drop area is keyboard accessible. Input sr-only. Clear upload instructions provided.
